name: UGC Unboxing
description: The parcel arrives, gets opened on camera, and the thing inside is held up to the lens. Casts one customer, anchors their face to a master frame, then walks three beats from doorstep to first use. The format for a physical product whose packaging and finish are part of the pitch.

product.description: What is in the box, named the way the brand names it.

expectation.description: What the viewer assumes before it is opened — the doubt the reveal answers.

detail.description: The one physical detail worth noticing up close: weight, texture, finish, smell.

presenter.description: Casting note, e.g. 'man, late 20s, flat share, dry and unimpressed'.

value.frame: Shot on an iPhone front-facing camera, handheld, vertical 9:16, photorealistic. Realistic skin texture with visible pores, faint freckles, natural skin sheen, no beauty filter, no airbrushing. Ordinary indoor light from a window and a ceiling lamp, uneven shadows. Casual clothing with real creases. Lived-in room with specific everyday clutter around the edges of frame. Slightly off-centre framing, mild phone-lens distortion, subtle grain. Both eyes open, looking straight down the lens. Unpolished amateur phone footage.
value.motion: Keep the exact same person, hair, wardrobe and room as the reference image. Handheld phone feel with slight unsteady framing. Real hands doing a real thing: cardboard bending, tape peeling, packaging rustling. Natural micro-movements, blinking, breathing. Continuous authentic phone footage, no cuts.
value.negative: eyes closed, mid-blink, looking away, head turned away, profile view, studio lighting, three-point lighting, cinematic colour grade, airbrushed skin, plastic skin, beauty filter, CGI, 3D render, stock photo, model headshot, polished commercial look, floating hands, warped hands, extra fingers, watermark, text overlay, subtitles

nodes.system: You cast and direct short-form UGC video. You write people who look like real customers filming themselves opening a parcel, never like models in an advert. You are specific about objects: what the box is made of, what is inside it, what their hands do. Dialogue is how people actually talk, one breath per line.

schema.actor: one paragraph pinning down age, build, hair, face, exact clothing and the specific room
schema.master_frame_prompt: still-image prompt for the opening frame with the sealed parcel

shots.frame_prompt: edit instruction from the master frame
shots.motion_prompt: action and delivery, with the spoken line in quotes

nodes.prompt:
{{shot.frame_prompt}}

Preserve the person's identity, facial structure, hair, wardrobe, room and lighting from the reference image exactly. Change only what is in their hands, their expression and the framing. Keep the eyes open.
